modmenu.descriptionTranslation.ppakemon_: Applies client setup once or on every launch before the game initializes.
screen.ppakemon_client_setup.title: Client Setup
screen.ppakemon_client_setup.description: Setup: apply CLC HUD and Xaero settings every launch; clean up keys once. Saved modes take effect on the next launch.
screen.ppakemon_client_setup.keybindings: Unbinds CLC HUD, Talking Heads, voice chat icon/mute, secondary zoom, badge box, Accessories screen, Crafting Tweaks, quick waypoint, ball comparison, riding free look, shader reload, and backpack slots 1/2. Sets PvP Room GUI to J, zoom to Left Alt, and smaller/larger panel text to =/-. Once mode preserves later personal settings.
screen.ppakemon_client_setup.xaero_help: Sets a round minimap in the top-right corner. Enables waypoints, keeps map teleport and deathpoints disabled, and shows icons. Map/settings use N/Y.
screen.ppakemon_client_setup.clc_missing: Cobbled Level Control is not installed.
screen.ppakemon_client_setup.read_failed: Could not read client setup. Check client.toml and the game log.
screen.ppakemon_client_setup.save_failed: Could not save. Check the game log.
screen.ppakemon_client_setup.saved: Saved. The selected mode takes effect on the next game launch.
